paragraphs.text: Kirri is a Cactusfolk druid from Thunder Junction .

Kirri is a young cactusfolk and companion of Yuma . He is a sturdy little cactus the size of a toddler, with six stumpy, spined arms. Smart but not emotive, he generally sits perfectly still in a basket in Yuma's bar, appearing as an ordinary potted cactus.

After arriving in Thunder Junction , Yuma encountered a newborn Kirri and took him under his care. Seeking a new life, Yuma opened a bar but was tracked down and confronted by his old friend Elnor . Their shootout resulted in much of Yuma's bar being consumed by fire, but Kirri intervened by reinforcing the building with intricate, interlacing vines that produced massive red flowers, the likes of which had never been seen before.
